description: Submits conversion options and queues a media conversion job. Images and videos in the session are converted to the specified format. The call is idempotent. Requires X-Api-Key header.

expiry.description: How long the converted files remain accessible after the job completes. Default: 1d. Free-tier keys are silently clamped to upload.free_max_expiry (default 1d); Pro accounts get the requested value.

image_format.description: Output format for image files. Default: jpeg.

image_resize_height.description: Resize images to fit within this bounding-box height in pixels. Longest-edge fit, aspect preserved, no upscaling.

image_resize_width.description: Resize images to fit within this bounding-box width in pixels. Longest-edge fit, aspect preserved, no upscaling.

pdf_dpi.description: PDF only. Render resolution in DPI. Default: 150.

pdf_page_from.description: PDF only. First page to render, 1-based. Default: 1.

pdf_page_to.description: PDF only. Last page to render, 1-based. 0 means all pages. Default: 0.

strip_metadata.description: Strip EXIF/GPS/encoder metadata from output files. Default: false.

video_crf.description: Video CRF value 0–51 (lower = better quality). Default: 23.

video_format.description: Output format for video files. Default: mp4h264.

video_max_dimension.description: Cap video resolution to this height in pixels. Omit for original resolution.

name: snapwonders_convert_job_start
